'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Chris Terwilliger DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet '''CTwigg'''; dest [[Chris Terwilliger]]. Sparse handwritten list.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Spice Mine Operations (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
